name: anti-defensive-ppt-writing
description: Chinese and English skills for evidence-led presentation storytelling and slide content.

interface.longDescription: Turn raw material into a coherent presentation narrative, informative slide titles, usable on-slide copy, evidence display suggestions and speaker cues. Includes Chinese and English skills. Preserve material risks, negative results, measurement context and user constraints. File authoring uses the host environment; this package contains instructions only, without a slide renderer, MCP server, login or telemetry.
defaultPrompt: 把这些材料整理成面向管理层的 8 页 PPT 内容，按任务给出逐页标题、简短文案及必要的图表内容，保留已确认的范围与术语。
Rewrite this presentation around a supported narrative. Provide slide titles, on-slide copy and evidence displays while retaining material qualifications.
帮我把这套汇报从过程流水账改成清晰的决策主线，删除导游词和重复说明，如实保留负向结果，不编造或夸大。

publication.release_notes: Initial PPT adaptation with Chinese and English skills, worked examples, quick prompts and complete resource packaging.
